info.title: tdbio
info.description: Command line tool that reports the structure of Tekla Structures model files, DSTV NC files, templates and reports.

commands.name: info
commands.description: The kind of the file and its main values.

commands.name: tables
commands.description: The table sections of a model database (.db1) or a DBV@ file, one line each.

commands.name: text
commands.description: The text chains of a model database (.db1), one line each. Save stamps show only their date.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write one JSON object instead of text.

options.name: --encoding
options.description:
The encoding of a template or report, instead of detecting it (info only).
Warnings go to stderr and do not change the exit code.
Exit codes: 0 done, 1 usage error, 2 input error (missing, malformed or unsupported file).
